blocks.text: (Updated as of October 23) MANILA, Philippines–The 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup has reached the playoffs stage, with eight teams vying to advance in the title race. The matchups in the crossover quarterfinals pit the NLEX Road Warriors against Phoenix Fuel Masters; Magnolia Hotshots against TNT Tropang 5G; Rain or Shine Elasto Painters against Converge FiberXers and Barangay Ginebra Gin Kings against San Miguel Beermen. The quarterfinals begin Sunday, with all series following a best-of-five format. If necessary, Games 5 to 7 are scheduled for November 4 onwards.
